title: Make sets from the basic vocabulary
intro: Pick from the 3,000 basic words of Korea's national English curriculum (800 marked for elementary school) and make them your own sets. They work like any other set: edit, assign and print.
aiNote: 뜻은 AI 초안, 교사 검토 권장 (meanings are an AI draft; please review)
aiNoteLong: Words and school levels come straight from the curriculum list; the Korean meanings are an AI draft. Please check them before assigning.
loadFailed: Could not load the basic vocabulary. Please try again.
none: No words match. Change the range or the search.
tooMany: Up to 40 sets at a time. Pick fewer sets or narrow the letters.
createFailed: Some sets were not made. Try again to continue with the rest.
discard: Sets are still being made. Closing stops the rest. Close anyway?
description: 2022 Korean national English curriculum basic vocabulary ({scope}). 뜻은 AI 초안, 교사 검토 권장.
appendHint: Adds the group's words after the editor rows. Words already on a front are skipped. Save in the editor.
